title: erucastrum humile
intro: Erucastrum humile, commonly known as Rocket Cress or Wormseed, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Erucastrum humile are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities. Additionally, the plant's seeds have been used as a natural deworming agent, hence its common name Wormseed.
